description: Data class for handling the server response for video likes, accommodating different possible JSON structures.

classes.name: LikesResponse
classes.description: Represents the response from the backend for the GET /videos/{id}/likes endpoint, with functions to resolve count and liked status.

methods.name: resolvedCount
methods.description: Returns the number of likes, prioritizing 'count', falling back to 'likes', or 0 if both are null.

methods.name: resolvedLiked
methods.description: Returns whether the video is liked, defaulting to false if 'liked' is null.
